note: droits pour NVIDIA d'investir dans IREN (jusqu'à 30 millions d'actions à 70,00 $, soit un apport potentiel en numéraire), acquis par tranches selon le volume de GPU que NVIDIA livre à IREN : conditionnalité liant un financement potentiel de NVIDIA aux achats de GPU d'IREN ; expirent le 7 mai 2031
quote: In connection with its arrangements with NVIDIA Corporation ("NVIDIA") for the supply of GPUs, on May 7, 2026 the Group granted NVIDIA rights to acquire up to 30,000,000 of the Company's Ordinary shares at an exercise price of $70.00 per share (the "Investment Rights"). The Investment Rights vest and become exercisable in tranches based on the volume of GPUs supplied by NVIDIA to the Group, and expire on May 7, 2031.
trigger_description: vest and become exercisable in tranches based on the volume of GPUs supplied by NVIDIA to the Group

note: juste valeur des droits remis à NVIDIA, incorporée au coût des GPU achetés à NVIDIA au fil des livraisons : contrepartie non monétaire payée au fournisseur ; traitement comptable publié liant les droits et les achats
quote: The grant-date fair value of the Investment Rights, determined using a Black-Scholes option-pricing model, was approximately $793.4 million. This amount will be capitalized as part of the cost of the GPUs acquired from NVIDIA and is recognized as the underlying GPUs are received by the Group, on a per-unit basis.

note: NVIDIA est aussi cliente d'IREN au titre d'un contrat de services de nuage, comptabilisé séparément des droits d'investissement ; aucun montant dans ce bloc
quote: The Investment Rights relate to the Group's supply arrangements with NVIDIA and are accounted for separately from the Company's cloud services agreement with NVIDIA, under which NVIDIA is a customer of the Group.
